explanation: The Holy Spirit who gives various gifts to believers for the building up of the community.
A gift from God, often called charisma, which is a special ability or service assigned to individuals in the church.
A unified image of the church where all believers form one unit with many different parts.
The individual members of the body (the church), each having their own function and significance.
Speaking in unknown languages or heavenly tongues, a gift from the Spirit for personal edification or public message with interpretation.
A speech where God gives a message to the church through a prophet to strengthen, comfort, and encourage believers.
The act of making tongues understandable to the whole church so that all may be built up.
The principle that everything in the worship service should take place in an orderly manner for everyone's benefit, not in disorder or chaos.
